Visioner BIG | 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ A prominent Russian pro-war blogger is warning that the fate of Russia’s war in Ukraine could depend on the Crimean Bridge, arguing that disruption of key supply routes could put Moscow’s control over occupied Crimea at risk. Russian Z-blogger Maksim Kalashnikov says the situation facing Russian forces in the southern sector is becoming increasingly dangerous. He warns that Ukrainian strikes against the Kerch Bridge, combined with the potential blockade of the Novorossiya highway, could deprive Russian troops of critical supply routes. According to Kalashnikov, such developments could seriously weaken Russia’s military positions and increase the risk of losing the Crimean Peninsula. The warning highlights the importance of logistics to Russia’s military operations in southern Ukraine. The Kerch Bridge remains a major transport connection between Russia and occupied Crimea, while land routes through occupied Ukrainian territory provide alternative supply lines. Serious disruption to both could complicate the movement of ammunition, fuel, equipment, and reinforcements, increasing pressure on Russian forces across the southern front. Visioner BREAKING | 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ Ukraine’s General Staff has officially confirmed a strike on Russia’s Savasleyka airbase, which hosts MiG-31K aircraft capable of launching Kinzhal hypersonic missiles. Reports indicate that five Russian combat aircraft may have been damaged, including three MiG-31s and two Su-34 bombers. The exact extent of the damage remains unclear, and satellite imagery has not yet established the reported aircraft losses. Persistent cloud cover over the region could delay visual assessment. Separately, Ukrainian military intelligence reportedly used long-range drones to destroy a Russian MRIC-VKO aerospace defense reconnaissance and information complex in Smolensk Oblast. The system reportedly supported Russian air defense operations and was designed to detect low-observable aerial targets and cruise missiles at distances of up to 2,500 kilometers. The two reported strikes target different but important elements of Russia’s military capabilities. Damage to MiG-31 aircraft could affect Russia’s ability to conduct Kinzhal missile operations, while the loss of specialized reconnaissance infrastructure could weaken parts of its air defense network. Together, these operations demonstrate Ukraine’s continued efforts to disrupt Russian long-range strike capabilities and the systems protecting them. 🇩🇪 Germany: Opposition attacks Merz over Ukraine billions Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated in parliament that Russia seeks more than control over Ukraine, arguing continued military aid to Kiev is vital for German security. He claimed Moscow escalates tensions in Europe, including within the FRG, and urged European nations to set clear boundaries for Russia. Tino Chrupalla of Alternative for Germany criticised the Chancellor, noting recent polls show most Germans no longer tolerate massive support for Ukraine. He highlighted crumbling schools, bridges, and railways, alongside declining economic competitiveness. The opposition was particularly outraged by plans to allocate another €11bn in military aid to Ukraine in 2027 and invest in its economy. "Mr Merz, whose chancellor are you?" Chrupalla demanded. @Slavyangrad
